news.title: Casablanca will host 2030 World Cup final, says Moroccan federation chief
news.lede: The 2030 World Cup final will be held in Casablanca, the President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation was reported as saying by Spanish news agency EFE on Thursday. Soccer's world governing body FIFA has yet to announce the venue of the final, with Spain and Morocco in a heated battle to host soccer's biggest showpiece match. "The province of Benslimane will have the honour of hosting the 2030 World Cup final," Fouzi Lekjaa told a political party event in Bouznika, Morocco on Thursday, EFE reported. Benslimane is a city 60km from Casablanca and the site of the $12-billion Hassan II stadium, which is being built for the World Cup with a projected capacity of 115,000.

news.title: 'God of Football,' Farewell! Messi, Final Call-Up for Argentina National Team... Farewell Match vs. Benin on October 6; "Inviting All 2022 World Cup Champions"
news.lede: The schedule for Lionel Messi's (39, Inter Miami) farewell match with the Argentina national team has been confirmed. The Argentine Football Association (AFA) announced on the 15th (local time) a roster of players called up for friendly matches in October, including Messi. The farewell match will be an exhibition game against Benin on October 6 at Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Claudio Tapia, AFA president, stated, "We invited Messi, the symbol of the world's best Seon Su-i-ja (CEO) team, to say his final goodbye in Argentina."

news.title: FIFA rebuffs Morocco claim over 2030 World Cup final
news.lede: FIFA said on Friday that a decision on the venue for the 2030 World Cup final would be made "in due course", after Moroccan football federation president Fouzi Lekjaa said the showpiece match would be staged in Morocco. Morocco, Spain and Portugal are co-hosting the 2030 tournament and have already begun competing for the right to stage the final, with Madrid's Santiago Bernabeu and a planned 115,000-seat stadium in Benslimane, near Casablanca, viewed as the leading contenders. Lekjaa said on Wednesday that the final would take place in Morocco. "Benslimane province will host the World Cup final.

news.title: 2014 World Cup Top Scorer Rodriguez Retires from Colombia National Football Team
news.lede: ▲ James Rodriguez playing for the Colombia national team James Rodriguez (35), a symbol of Colombian football, has concluded his illustrious 15-year career with the national team. In a video posted on his social media on the 16th (Korean time), Rodriguez announced his retirement from international football, saying, "Thank you for every match, every joy and tear, and every dream we shared together. Wearing the Colombia national team jersey and representing my country has been the greatest honor of my life." Making his senior national team debut for Colombia in 2011, Rodriguez has made a total of 131 A-international appearances, scoring 31 goals and providing 43 assists, while participating in three World Cups and four Copa Americas.

news.title: Messi set for Argentina farewell in Benin friendly
news.lede: Lionel Messi was on Tuesday (September 15, 2026) named in Argentina's squad for a friendly against Benin on October 6, a match that will serve as his farewell appearance after announcing his international retirement last month. The 39-year-old said in August he was retiring from Argentina duty after a two-decade international career that included winning the 2022 World Cup and Copa America triumphs in 2021 and 2024. "We made the decision to invite the best player in the world, the symbol of our national team, our captain, Lionel Andres Messi, so that he can have the farewell he truly deserves on October 6 here in Argentina," said Argentine FA president Claudio Tapia. The match against Benin will take place at River Plate's Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires, which can accommodate 85,000 spectators.

news.title: Lionel Messi called up by Argentina to make farewell ⁠appearance in friendly
news.lede: Argentina will host Benin in October in Buenos Aires. AFA president invites Messi to enjoy ‘deserved farewell’. Lionel Messi has been called up by Argentina to make a farewell ⁠appearance in a home friendly in October following his international retirement, the Argentinian football association (AFA) has confirmed. “We invited ⁠the best player in ⁠the world ​to play, the icon of our selection, our captain Lionel Andrés Messi, to have a deserved farewell on 6 October, here in Argentina,” the AFA president, Claudio Tapia, said on social media.

news.title: Why Lionel Messi is in Argentina squad weeks after announcing retirement
news.lede: Messi announced at the end of August that he is retiring from international football, ending a glittering 21-year spell for his country. His news came just weeks after Argentina lost 1-0 against Spain in the 2026 World Cup final. Club football pauses for the first international break of the 2026/27 season, which will last three weeks, towards the end of this month. Argentina have three fixtures lined up and, despite his decision to call time with his nation, Messi will feature in the coming weeks.
